sentences.text:
For the Respondents : Mr. Vijayant Verma, J.C. to G.P. Ii
 5/12.08.2016

Mr. Mukesh Kumar, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner has submitted that Section 42 of the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 has not been properly followed as one of the sample which was taken by the Food Safety Officer was not given to the petitioner to be tested in an accredited laboratory.
It is submitted that parameters with respect to the testing of the paneer which was analysed to be sub standard has not been followed.

Mr. Vijayant Verma, learned J.C. to G.P. II seeks three weeks time to file counter-affidavit.
List this case after three weeks.

In the meantime, impugned order dated 18.04. 2016 by which petitioner was given penalty of Rs.
50,000/- under Section 51 of the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 shall remain stayed.

(Rongon Mukhopadhyay, J.) Binit Guru Pado Thakur vs The State Of Jharkhand And Ors on 12 August, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122639550/
